posts.text:
None of this will impact the financial impact at all and Ed’s lies will be laid bare when they give their financials looking back at IPO. What I want is for people to recognize reality. Society needs to react not deny.

Our Anthropic shares are entirely in our foundation - no personal benefit.
Maybe you don’t follow Ed enough to know how he has been lying about this. I don’t care about the phrase, the point is where the gross margins are.

Per the other thread all Anthropic holdings are in the foundation, dedicated to charity.

The “AI is a scam” narrative was annoying last year. It is itself the scam among the people who continue to peddle it. Great changes are coming and people need to stop burying their heads in the sand.

I politely engaged Ed a dozen times with no acknowledgement and now I am simply recognizing him as a charlatan. I’m being direct so that people see it clearly instead of playing word games like he does.

I'm a long way from Meta at this point. We have given away $5B and we have about $20B more in the foundation and some more personal (you can look on bloomberg for that). The foundation is invested in Anthropic as well.
Another way of looking at our giving over the past 8 years.
Small correction for posterity … not all (but still most) of the $20B is in the foundation but still nonetheless committed in principle
